mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friend_request (requester_id, target_user_id, status, message, handled_by, handled_at) VALUES (#{requesterId}, #{targetUserId}, #{status}, #{message}, #{handledBy}, #{handledAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, requester_id, target_user_id, status, message, handled_by, handled_at, created_at, updated_at FROM friend_request WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, requester_id, target_user_id, status, message, handled_by, handled_at, created_at, updated_at FROM friend_request WHERE requester_id = #{requesterId} AND target_user_id = #{targetUserId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, requester_id, target_user_id, status, message, handled_by, handled_at, created_at, updated_at FROM friend_request WHERE target_user_id = #{targetUserId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE friend_request SET status = #{status}, handled_by = #{handledBy}, handled_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
